summary: Scanned-looking mid-rise lease (wrapped lines, page headers). Deposit may sit in the operating account, notice counts weekends, a balcony rule bans flags, abandoned-property clause lacks the legend.

findings.quote: The deposit may be held in any account maintained by Lessor, including Lessor's operating account,
allowing Lessee three (3) calendar days, including weekends and holidays, to comply.
Nothing may be hung from, attached to, or displayed on any balcony, patio, railing or window, including flags of any kind, banners, signs, laundry or towels.
After Lessee surrenders or abandons the Apartment, Lessor may remove and dispose of any personal property remaining in it, and Lessor will have no liability for that property.

findings.note: bank and interest stated, but no 83.49(2)(d) statutory notice

outOfScope.quote: If any rent is not received by 11:59 p.m. on the third day of the month, Lessee will pay an initial late charge of $75.00 plus $10.00 per day thereafter until paid, not to exceed $150.00 in total for any month. A $50.00 fee applies to any returned payment.

No animals of any kind, including visiting animals, are allowed in the Apartment without a signed animal addendum, except assistance animals approved as required by law. Approved pets require a nonrefundable pet fee of $350 and monthly pet rent of $35 per animal.
To the extent permitted by law, Lessor and Lessee waive trial by jury in any lawsuit arising out of this Lease or Lessee's occupancy of the Apartment.

nearMisses.quote: Lessee must obtain and keep in force during the Lease term a renter's insurance policy with personal liability coverage of at least $100,000 and must provide proof of coverage before move-in and upon request. Lessor's property insurance covers the building, not Lessee's furniture, clothing, electronics or other belongings, and does not provide liability coverage for Lessee.
nearMisses.note: landlord's insurance doesn't cover tenant property: a fact, not a release

nearMisses.quote: Lessee will pay Lessor for the reasonable cost of repairing any damage to the Apartment or the community, including stopped-up drains and broken windows, that is caused by Lessee, occupants, guests or animals, whether by negligence, misuse or violation of this Lease. Normal wear and tear is excepted.
nearMisses.note: reimbursing tenant-caused damage: not a maintenance waiver
